name: One-Minute Arrive
description: A single minute to arrive in the moment: feet, seat, hands, breath, and what is next.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A one-minute, six-step arrival, on Guided Pause.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. A few steps is as good as all six.
howToPlay: Press Begin when you are ready.
Each step lasts ten seconds and then moves on by itself.
Press Next to skip a step, or Back to repeat one.
tips: This is a break, not advice. Skip any step that does not suit you.
